summary: Asynchronous video messaging tool acquired by Atlassian — browser recording APIs make clones easy to vibe-code.
moat: Loom's moat is Atlassian distribution: being bundled into Jira, Confluence, and Trello protects it within enterprise knowledge stacks, with over 21 million users. Instant video encoding and auto-generated transcripts provide seamless asynchronous communication. However, browser MediaRecorder APIs and AI video summary startups allow indie hackers to replicate core screen recording and AI transcription in days.

challengers.name: AI screen recorder clones (Tella, Screen Studio, Komodo)
challengers.evidence: Modern AI video tools generate auto-zoomed screen recordings and translated dubbing in one click, matching Loom's feature set while undercutting its enterprise pricing.

sources.label: Screen Studio and modern video recording tools
